reviews.review:
I feel absolutely ashamed that I ever fell in love with this game and became so engrossed in the theories for more than a year. I even learned a bit of Russian so that I could understand the YouTube videos better.
BUT IT'S ALL FOR NOTHING. There is no coherent vision for episode 5. The developers, Saikono, Sokarev, and whoever else, mixed psychedelics and laxatives and took a giant ♥♥♥♥ all over the first 4 episodes and just called it a "final episode". I am genuinely just baffled that someone can ♥♥♥♥ up a story this badly, it doesn't feel like it's merely an internal miscommunication or misdirection of vision. Even if you had writer's block, for example, it doesn't mean that you can just upend the entire atmosphere of the first 4 episodes and spin it into some kind of crazy Evangelion-Kaiju-Harem-♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥.
The ending branches with the adult characters feel more like Tiny Bunny fanfiction than something the creators of the story would feel logical enough to put in. In fact, I suspect that the developers hosted all these fanfiction competitions to grab ideas from their fans because they don't have any. Oh, and the art is barely anything but 3D models, and even worse, AI. Shame on you, Saikono. I hope you never get international exposure.
